g.text: about:config for P123: changes go to the project (L switches)
description How many proposals one AI agent may create per UTC day.
docs Accepted, rejected and failed proposals count too. 0 stops every agent from proposing. The environment variable
TL_AGENT_DAILY_PROPOSALS, when set, overrides this value for the process.
risk advanced: a reason is required
